from solution import upper_ctr
import inspect


def test_issue_single_leading_upper():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string with one leading uppercase."""
    assert upper_ctr('Python') == 1  # P=1 + ython=0 => 1


def test_issue_example_string_two_uppers():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string 'PYthon' has two."""
    assert upper_ctr('PYthon') == 2  # P=1 + Y=1 + thon=0 => 2


def test_issue_empty_string():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string handles empty input."""
    assert upper_ctr('') == 0  # no chars => 0


def test_issue_all_lowercase():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string with all lowercase."""
    assert upper_ctr('python') == 0  # 0+0+0+0+0+0 => 0


def test_issue_all_uppercase():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string with all uppercase."""
    assert upper_ctr('ABC') == 3  # 1+1+1 => 3


def test_issue_mixed_alternating_case():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string with alternating case."""
    assert upper_ctr('aBcDeF') == 3  # a=0,B=1,c=0,D=1,e=0,F=1 => 3


def test_issue_no_letters():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string with no letters."""
    assert upper_ctr('1234!?') == 0  # digits/symbols=0 => 0


def test_issue_sentence_with_space():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string with spaces."""
    assert upper_ctr('Hello World') == 2  # H=1 + ello=0 + space=0 + W=1 + orld=0 => 2


def test_issue_single_upper_char():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string with single uppercase."""
    assert upper_ctr('A') == 1  # A=1 => 1


def test_issue_single_lower_char():
    """Count the upper case characters in a given string with single lowercase."""
    assert upper_ctr('z') == 0  # z=0 => 0


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Counting upper case characters must return an int count."""
    result = upper_ctr('AbC')  # A=1 + b=0 + C=1 => 2
    assert isinstance(result, int)


def test_contract_single_parameter():
    """Implement upper_ctr(str) in solution.py with one parameter."""
    assert len(inspect.signature(upper_ctr).parameters) == 1  # one param => 1
